title: Paydown Rate Cut for PracticePay Patient Financing Resets
content:
**Rule.** The paydown rate cut of a PracticePay Patient Financing payment reset compares the principal left on the plan's ledger, the financed charge plus returned payments less payments and provider refunds, with the financed amount: no more than 0.5 of the financed amount gives 0.5 percentage points, above that but no more than 0.75 of it gives 0.25 percentage points, and more gives 0.

| Principal left, as a share of the financed amount | Rate cut (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| no more than one half | 0.5 |
| above one half, no more than three quarters | 0.25 |
| above three quarters | 0 |

*Hypothetical.* Financed amount 4000.00. Principal left 2000.00 (exactly one half): 0.5. Principal left 3000.00 (exactly three quarters): 0.25. Principal left 3100.00: 0.
